description: Orient Rental Modaraba is a multi-purpose, perpetual Modaraba formed by spinning off the generator rental and operation-and-maintenance divisions of Orient Energy Systems, which is owned by the Modaraba's major sponsors. It is managed by Eman Management (Private) Limited and offers Shariah-compliant equipment rental on Ijarah, currently gas and diesel generators with turnkey solutions including aftersales support and operations and maintenance. It has stated an intention to add commercial vehicles, material handling equipment and construction machinery to its portfolio.
